title: Long non-coding RNAs in biomarking COVID-19: a machine learning-based approach.
authors: Heydari, Raheleh; Tavassolifar, Mohammad Javad; Fayazzadeh, Sara; Sadatpour, Omid; Meyfour, Anna
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习分析COVID-19患者lncRNA表达作为生物标志物，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The coronavirus pandemic that started in 2019 has caused the highest mortality and morbidity rates worldwide. Data on the role of long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) in coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) is scarce. We aimed to elucidate the relationship of three important lncRNAs in the inflammatory states, H19, taurine upregulated gene 1 (TUG1), and colorectal neoplasia differentially expressed (CRNDE) with key factors in inflammation and fibrosis induction including signal transducer and activator of transcription3 (STAT3), alpha smooth muscle actin (alpha-SMA), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), and interleukin-6 (IL-6) in COVID-19 patients with moderate to severe symptoms. METHODS: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells from 28 COVID-19 patients and 17 healthy controls were collected. The real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) was performed to evaluate the expression of RNAs and lncRNAs. Western blotting analysis was also performed to determine the expression levels of STAT3 and alpha-SMA proteins. Machine learning and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis were carried out to evaluate the distinguishing ability of lncRNAs. RESULTS: The expression levels of H19, TUG1, and CRNDE were significantly overexpressed in COVID-19 patients compared to healthy controls. Moreover, STAT3 and alpha-SMA expression levels were remarkedly increased at both transcript and protein levels in patients with COVID-19 compared to healthy subjects and were correlated with Three lncRNAs. Likewise, IL-6 and TNF-alpha were considerably upregulated in COVID-19 patients. Machine learning and ROC curve analysis showed that CRNDE-H19 panel has the proper ability to distinguish COVID-19 patients from healthy individuals (area under the curve (AUC) = 0.86). CONCLUSION: The overexpression of three lncRNAs in COVID-19 patients observed in this study may align with significant manifestations of COVID-19. Furthermore, their co-expression with STAT3 and alpha-SMA, two critical factors implicated in inflammation and fibrosis induction, underscores their potential involvement in exacerbating cardiovascular, pulmonary and common symptoms and complications associated with COVID-19. The combination of CRNDE and H19 lncRNAs seems to be an impressive host-based biomarker panel for screening and diagnosis of COVID-19 patients from healthy controls. Research into lncRNAs can provide a robust platform to find new viral infection-related mediators and propose novel therapeutic strategies for viral infections and immune disorders.
abstract_zh: 背景：自2019年开始的新型冠状病毒大流行已在全球范围内造成最高的死亡率和发病率。关于长链非编码RNA（lncRNAs）在2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）中作用的数据较为稀缺。本研究旨在阐明三种重要的lncRNAs——H19、牛磺酸上调基因1（TUG1）和结直肠肿瘤差异表达基因（CRNDE）——在炎症状态中与炎症及纤维化诱导关键因子，包括信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）、α平滑肌肌动蛋白（alpha-SMA）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）和白细胞介素-6（IL-6）之间的关系，研究对象为中重度症状的COVID-19患者。方法：收集28名COVID-19患者和17名健康对照者的外周血单核细胞。采用实时定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）评估RNA和lncRNAs的表达。同时进行Western blotting分析以测定STAT3和alpha-SMA蛋白的表达水平。采用机器学习和受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析评估lncRNAs的区分能力。结果：与健康对照相比，COVID-19患者中H19、TUG1和CRNDE的表达水平显著过表达。此外，与健康受试者相比，COVID-19患者中STAT3和alpha-SMA在转录本和蛋白质水平上的表达均显著增加，并与三种lncRNAs相关。同样，IL-6和TNF-alpha在COVID-19患者中显著上调。机器学习和ROC曲线分析显示，CRNDE-H19组合具有区分COVID-19患者与健康个体的良好能力（曲线下面积（AUC）= 0.86）。结论：本研究中观察到的COVID-19患者中三种lncRNAs的过表达可能与COVID-19的显著表现相一致。此外，它们与STAT3和alpha-SMA（炎症和纤维化诱导中涉及的两个关键因子）的共表达，强调了它们在加剧与COVID-19相关的心血管、肺部及常见症状和并发症中的潜在作用。CRNDE和H19 lncRNAs的组合似乎是用于从健康对照中筛查和诊断COVID-19患者的有效宿主生物标志物组合。对lncRNAs的研究可为发现新的病毒感染相关介质提供坚实平台，并为病毒感染和免疫疾病提出新的治疗策略。
